metadata.description: Astro dev server with HMR for the QAuth documentation site (Starlight).
Static build of the QAuth documentation site. Output lands at dist/apps/docs-site via astro.config.mjs's outDir.

Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs` (which only covers {projectRoot}/**/* — this project's own files). Several of this project's invariants tests read outside apps/docs-site at runtime. status-claims.test.ts reads README.md and docs/README.md; endpoint-coverage.test.ts reads apps/auth-server/src/app/routes/** (both fixed in issue #350 fix-round-1 — without declaring them, editing either left this target's cache hash unchanged, so a fixed guard replayed a stale cached pass instead of re-running against the new content). anchor-validity.test.ts is the harder case (fix-round-2): it checks that every `path:line` anchor quoted in content names a file that still exists anywhere under apps/ or libs/ — an unbounded set that can't be listed exactly, so apps/**/*.ts and libs/**/*.ts are declared coarsely (every .ts source file, not just the ones some anchor happens to reference today). Without this, deleting or renaming a .ts file some content page anchors to would leave a broken anchor behind a cached pass — exactly the drift class this guard exists to catch. `**/*` across the whole workspace was deliberately avoided: it would also hash dist/, coverage/, and other generated output for no benefit anchors could ever point at. Setting `inputs` on an already-inferred target REPLACES the inferred array rather than merging into it, so the first six entries above are the inferred defaults re-declared, not new — drop one and its category of input silently stops being hashed.

Type-check via `astro check` (checks .astro/.mdx content through Astro's language server, not just tsc). Overrides the @nx/js/typescript-inferred target, which fails on this project (see Task 1 report: TS5069 without composite/declaration, then TS2883 from docsSchema()/Zod v4 under declaration-emit).
Preview the static build of the QAuth documentation site (serves dist/apps/docs-site).
